appraisal_events.evidence: je ne pus... la reconnaître en une dame aux traits tellement déchiquetés que la ligne du visage n'était pas restituable... Ses yeux, profondément cernés de noir, étaient presque hagards. Sa bouche avait un rictus étrange.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator sharply diminishes the vicomtesse by describing her face as ravaged beyond recognition, explicitly attributed to years of cocaine and drug use, overturning her earlier appearance of assured, sculptural, eternal youth.

appraisal_events.evidence: Je pris M. de Courgivaux pour son fils, car il avait l'air plus jeune (il devait avoir dépassé la cinquantaine et semblait plus jeune qu'à trente ans)... il était revenu à la trentaine et semblait même, ce jour-là, ne pas l'avoir atteinte.
appraisal_events.explanation: As the counter-case to premature aging, Courgivaux is narratively elevated: having given up alcohol and salt under a good doctor's care, he is mistaken for his own son and appears younger than he did decades earlier.

status_effects.explanation: Her local standing in the narrator's perception collapses from a figure whose sculptural features seemed to guarantee eternal youth to one disfigured almost beyond recognition by drug use.
He comes out locally ahead as a rare instance of reversed aging, appearing younger than his own son and younger than his former self.
